title: Ark of the Covenant claimed kept at Aksum
place_text: Chapel beside Church of St Mary of Zion, Aksum, Tigray, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: we have the we have the Ark of the Covenant here

plain: The Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest that in the Bible held the tablets of the Ten Commandments, is said to be kept in a chapel beside the Church of St Mary of Zion in Aksum, a town in Ethiopia. The writer Graham Hancock tells Jesse Michels he went there himself and was told "we have the Ark of the Covenant here", a search he wrote up in his book The Sign and the Seal. If true, one of the most famous lost objects in history would still be in one place, guarded.
